text:
**Ledgerly 5.0 (released 21 October 2026): key points**

Thank you for your interest in Ledgerly 5.0, which was released on 21 October 2026. The main points are summarised below, grouped by topic so you can review them quickly.

**Action needed:** Please be aware that the Classic CSV export has been removed. If any team exports data to another accounting system or a spreadsheet, those imports will **break after updating**. This is because the new format uses different column names and places GST in its own column. Before updating, please see the help article "Moving from Classic CSV."

**Also note:** Please also be aware that Android 9 will no longer receive updates.

**New features:** This release introduces automatic recurring invoices, bulk reminders for overdue invoices, and dark mode.

**Improvements:** Several improvements have been made in this version. The dashboard is faster for large accounts, client search has been improved, and GST rounding is now ATO-aligned. This release also includes fixes for the Western Australia due-date error, an iOS crash and duplicate notifications.

**Coming soon:** Looking ahead, multi-currency invoicing and credit union bank feeds are planned for future releases.
